articles.title: Sanctuary for All
articles.author: Rochester Red Star: News from Rochester DSA
articles.content_excerpt: The following remarks were delivered by ROC DSA Co-Chair Gregory Lebens-Higgins at the Rochester Contemporary Art Center’s (RoCo) “Route of Refusal: A Public Art Walk” on Saturday, October 3, held as part of the national 2026 Fall of Freedom weekend . The event mixed creative art and expression with community and activism, including poetry that invoked words censored by the Trump regime, and collective music-making. articles.title: Getting Fired from Mother Jones Made Michael Moore
articles.author: Bhaskar Sunkara
articles.content_excerpt: Before Paul Berman became a liberal hawk, he was a New Left veteran who edited a book called Quotations from the Anarchists . In 1986, his long-standing anxiety about the authoritarian left may have produced a casualty: Michael Moore’s magazine career. Moore had edited Mother Jones for five months when he tried to kill the second installment of Berman’s two-part commissioned dispatch on Nicaragua. Berman did identify the Contras as US-financed, traced their leadership to Anastasio Somoza Debayle’s National Guard, and acknowledged the “blood on their hands.” But his overarching concern was Sandinista Leninism: their restrictions on political competition and refusal to share power. articles.title: Reckoning With the Failures of Tech Worker Organizing
articles.author: Alex N. Press
articles.content_excerpt: In early 2022, a group of Twitter employees were quietly trying to unionize the company. They called themselves the “Starlings” after the birds whose synchronized flight patterns offer one another safety and warmth. The workers mapped out their coworkers and assessed their pro- or antiunion sentiments, held one-on-one conversations, and tried to stay off of management’s radar while they built toward a majority. Then Elon Musk bought Twitter. Half the workforce disappeared in the first round of layoffs , with cuts falling heavily on trust and safety and other teams where the union had organizers. articles.title: Trump’s Politically Driven Deportations Are Quietly Rising
articles.author: Branko Marcetic
articles.content_excerpt: Donald Trump’s approval on immigration is so deathly low, and his ongoing deportation raids so unpopular even in red states, that you’d be forgiven for thinking his administration has pumped the brakes on the issue. Instead the White House is advancing a radical agenda that is increasingly targeted not at criminals or even law-abiding undocumented people but at legal immigrants. Pro-Palestinian activist and green card holder Mahmoud Khalil may have staved off his politically motivated deportation, but the Trump administration is only expanding its targeting of permanent residents. articles.title: The West Is Only Helping Putin Consolidate Support
articles.author: Leonid Ragozin
articles.content_excerpt: At the “We Shall Not Be Moved” event in New York on September 21, Senator Bernie Sanders delivered a programmatic speech that attacked the United States’ staggering trillion-dollar war budget. He described the war industry draining the life out of society as a global and not just American problem. This is why, he said, progressives should oppose Donald Trump’s war in Iran, Israel’s genocide in Gaza, and the United Arab Emirates’ proxy war in Sudan. This is also why “we must rally and work with grassroots activists in Russia to put an end to Putin’s disastrous war in Ukraine,” Sanders asserted.
